name: batch-04
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A thick golden-brown cake slice with a pale cream top and warm crumb-colored sides rests on a pale ceramic plate with a muted teal rim; one small golden coin is visible at the front of the slice. Preserve the cut slice and single coin, without icing words, dates or extra decorations.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A plain ivory-white silk scarf hangs in a broad open U-shaped fold, with two long narrow ends and short pale tassel fringes. Preserve the soft fabric drape and empty center, without printed symbols, embroidery or extra knots.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A tall cream paper gift bag with a red cord handle holds two long pink-and-white wrapped candy sticks protruding from the top; the bag has a coral lower band and a simple coral flower mark. Preserve the slender candy and paper-bag forms, without invented lettering or extra motifs.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A tapered mound of gray-green stacked stones with pale horizontal stone edges supports a slender brown pole and one small blue cloth strip fluttering to the right. Keep the low irregular stone pile and single blue strip, without extra banners or sacred symbols.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A small golden infant Buddha figure stands in a broad muted teal water basin, with the arm on the viewer's left raised and the other lowered; a small brown wooden ladle pours a thin blue water stream near the shoulder. Keep the simple original figure pose, basin and ladle, without added jewelry, script or surrounding offerings.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A shallow folded pale green coconut-leaf tray holds distinct yellow, blue-violet, ivory-white and coral-pink flower clusters around small green central leaves. Preserve the angular leaf-fold seams and four-color flower arrangement, without adding flames, burning incense or new decorations.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A slender brown dogwood branch forms two stacked open rounded loops, decorated with a few ivory popcorn-like pieces and short coral-red wool tassels. Preserve the open looped twig structure and sparse tied decorations, without extra ribbons, bells or lettering.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A small tan sand pagoda rises in three tapering stepped tiers beside a slender bamboo pole with a top crossbar and one pale orange notched paper banner. Keep the sand texture, separate side pole and unlettered hanging paper; no added temple ornaments or script.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: One bright red square paper rotated into a diamond bears the existing upright black geometric 福 character. Preserve the crisp paper corners, correct upright character and single-sheet composition; no added words, border patterns or tassels.
